growth_sign.sign: enhancement (wrong direction for resolving the S8 tension)
growth_sign.interpretation: TEP modifies the growth history through the tep_mode Jordan-frame Hubble factor M(z) = A/(1-alpha_A). At epsilon_T = 0.0066 the net effect is a +0.13% uplift of sigma8 at z=0 and -0.10% at z=0.5 — sub-percent and scale-free, as expected for a pure-background modification. A resolution of the DES-Y3/KiDS S8 amplitude would require suppression of order 8-10%, which the CMB-bounded epsilon_T cannot supply in the linear homogeneous closure.

perturbation_channel.finding: tep_pert_post (gravity_model=tep, Bellini-Sawicki alphas active) and tep_bg_post (tep_mode background only) produce distinct mPk products at z=0 and z=0.5 on the corrected build: the SMG alpha sector is genuinely active in the matter power spectrum, with a bounded sub-percent correction on the screened w_c=700 branch (see results/closure_response_scan.json for the full response curve). The earlier bitwise-identical result reflected a background-density gate that silently disabled the SMG sector in the pre-audit build.

pk_boundary_artifact.finding: The registered pk grids are extended to P_k_max_h/Mpc = 20 (k_scalar_max_tau0_over_l_max = 80) and terminate at k ~ 21 h/Mpc. The rising deviation previously seen near the old grid edge (k ~ 0.45-1.0 h/Mpc, reaching +44%) is absent on the extended grid: it was a grid-boundary artifact of the pk output, not a physical scale-dependent feature. On the extended grid the TEP/LCDM deviation is flat and sub-percent for k > 0.45 h/Mpc; the only residual is at the low-k end, where the active SMG scalar sources a genuine ~1%% correction. The integrated impact of the high-k region on sigma8 through the 8 Mpc/h top-hat is below 0.02%%.

prior_saturation.finding: The low-ell-only CMB chain lacks the high-ell acoustic lever arm that fixes A_planck and n_s. A_planck pins at its U[0.9,1.1] ceiling and n_s at its U[0.94,1.0] ceiling; sigma8 is strongly slaved to the calibration nuisance (corr = +0.46). Widening A_planck to U[0.9,1.25] moves the posterior to A_planck = 1.233 and sigma8 = 0.923 (S8 ~ 0.93): the S8 posterior is controlled by the prior width, not the likelihood. The quoted S8 = 0.868 +/- 0.025 therefore cannot be read as a TEP prediction of the z=0 clustering amplitude; the data-consistent value at fiducial cosmology is sigma8 = 0.824 (S8 = 0.824*sqrt(0.314/0.3) = 0.843), statistically indistinguishable from the LCDM value at the same cosmology.

honest_tension.finding: At the shared fixed cosmology the TEP-versus-external gap equals the LCDM-versus-external gap to within 0.1 sigma of the external error bar: TEP inherits, and does not resolve or worsen, the standard Planck-CMB versus weak-lensing S8 tension. The 3-4 sigma offset sometimes quoted from the joint-MCMC z=0 extrapolation is dominated by prior-boundary saturation of A_planck and n_s in the low-ell-only likelihood (section 4), not by TEP physics.
